hypothesis: The load-use interlock is no longer derived from the wrong place, but its *application scope* is still wrong: stall_load_use is allowed to hold the MEM-side state (ex_mem_valid / the registered dmem_valid-dmem_we-dmem_addr-dmem_wdata bundle) or dmem_valid is not a one-shot pulse qualified by 'the pipeline actually advanced'. The MEM stage therefore drives dmem_valid for two consecutive cycles for a store that happens to be resident in MEM during a load-use stall, which is exactly the observed +1 write transaction (t07: 2 writes instead of 1; t08: 8 instead of 7). The same missing 'advance' qualification delays the MEM->EX forwarding sample by one cycle and lets the consumer of the load observe the EX/MEM entry (ALU address/old value) instead of the load data, so the LBU-heavy crc32 loop and the load->add accumulation chain of array_sum64 compute on stale operands: x3 = 0x5209cacb instead of 0x004519f6 and exit_code = 0x00001000 instead of 0x00000820. Fix direction: make stall_load_use freeze ONLY PC, IF/ID and ID/EX, inject exactly one EX bubble by clearing the ID/EX valid without destroying the instruction in IF/ID, keep EX/MEM, MEM/WB and the memory outputs always advancing, and make dmem_valid a single-cycle qualified pulse (rst_n low or halted -> 0).
constraints: Top-level port list and port names/directions of rv32i5 must stay exactly as frozen in the spec.
Synchronous active-low reset: dmem_valid, dmem_we, halted, exit_code and every registered output must be 0 during rst_n low and before the first reset edge.
stall_load_use must freeze only PC, IF/ID and ID/EX for exactly one cycle and inject exactly one bubble into EX; it must never clear or drop a valid instruction from IF/ID.
EX/MEM and MEM/WB registers must never be frozen by stall_load_use; each in-flight instruction may drive dmem_valid for at most one cycle (one load -> one read, one store -> one write).
dmem_valid must be gated by rst_n and halted, and must be suppressed (0) in any cycle where the MEM-stage instruction does not newly advance.

Forwarding must keep both EX/MEM->EX and MEM/WB->EX paths with EX/MEM priority, never forward when rd==x0 or when the source field is x0, and a load's forwarded value must be the load data, not the ALU address.
Branch/JAL/JALR stay resolved in EX with 2-instruction flush of IF/ID and ID/EX and JALR target (rs1+imm)&32'hffff_fffe; redirect has priority over a simultaneous load-use stall.
Only WB may set halted/exit_code, and only for a committed ECALL (instruction word 32'h0000_0073); after halt, PC fetch freezes and no new dmem transaction may be issued.
Do not modify the teacher testbench, the spec, or the scoring scripts; do not hardcode test vectors or fake debug/capability flags.
